about.title: Bridging the Gap Between Citizens and the Law
about.challenge.title: The Problem: Scattered, Dense, and Intimidating
about.challenge.p1: Indian law touches every aspect of daily life, yet complicated legal jargon and scattered statutory texts leave millions of citizens and small businesses confused.
about.challenge.p2: With the landmark transition from the colonial IPC, CrPC, and Evidence Act to the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA), understanding legal rights has become even more overwhelming.
about.mission.title: Our Solution: Clear, Structured, and Responsible
about.mission.p1: VIDHIVRAKSH was built to transform dense statutory provisions into clear, understandable explanations without sacrificing precision.
about.mission.p2: VIDHIVRAKSH does not replace lawyers or provide formal legal representation. Instead, VIDHIVRAKSH empowers people to understand where they stand, what questions to ask, and how to arrive at a legal consultation better informed.
features.header.title: Explore What VIDHIVRAKSH Can Do
features.header.subtitle: From simplifying everyday legal jargon to navigating the new criminal codes, VIDHIVRAKSH provides structured legal clarity across ten specialized modules.
features.item1.title: Simplify Legal Jargon
features.item1.desc: Demystify complex legal phrases, Latin maxims, and statutory terms into plain, understandable language.
features.item1.detail: Interactive breakdown of terms like caveat emptor, cognizable offence, prima facie, and interim injunction with Indian law context.
features.item2.title: Agreement and Contract Explainer
features.item2.desc: Understand rental agreements, employment contracts, non-disclosure agreements, and service terms.
features.item2.detail: Highlights essential clauses, termination terms, security deposit obligations, and notice period requirements under Indian contract law.
features.item3.title: FIR Explainer
features.item3.desc: Step-by-step guidance on First Information Reports, cognizable vs non-cognizable offences, and citizen rights.
features.item3.detail: Explains citizen rights during filing, zero-FIR procedures, free copy entitlement under BNSS, and legal remedies if police refuse registration.
features.item4.title: Local Laws and Challan Information
features.item4.desc: Explore traffic violations, municipal bylaws, public noise rules, and digital challan verification procedures.
features.item4.detail: Motor Vehicles Act penalty schedules, Lok Adalat resolution guidelines, and contest procedures for disputed traffic e-challans.
features.item5.title: IPC → BNS Explorer
features.item5.desc: Instant comparative mapping from the historical Indian Penal Code to the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).
features.item5.detail: Side-by-side section cross-references (e.g. IPC Section 420 to BNS Section 318(4), Section 302 to Section 103) with key modifications explained.
features.item6.title: Legal Document Library
features.item6.desc: Browse standard sample templates for affidavits, rent agreements, wills, RTI applications, and legal notices.
features.item6.detail: Curated structural checklists, required witness criteria, and stamp-duty guidance for common legal documents in India.
features.item7.title: Document Review and Consistency Checker
features.item7.desc: Review draft documents for inconsistent clauses, ambiguous terms, or missing vital disclosures.
features.item7.detail: Flags potentially contradictory dates, unbalanced indemnities, vague dispute-resolution clauses, and unsigned schedules.
features.item8.title: Land Ownership Research — Demo
features.item8.desc: Understand land title verification, Encumbrance Certificates (EC), and registry document structures.
features.item8.detail: Demonstrates how public land records (7/12 extract, Patta/Chitta, RoR) are structured and what due-diligence checks are needed before buying property.
features.item9.title: Business Dispute and Arbitration Support
features.item9.desc: Guidance for MSMEs on payment recovery under the MSMED Act, arbitration clauses, and pre-litigation mediation.
features.item9.detail: Samadhaan portal filing workflows, fast-track commercial dispute timelines, and arbitration clause enforceability.
features.item10.title: Lawyer Case Management
features.item10.desc: Structured case tracking, statutory note-taking, hearing dates, and research briefing for advocates.
features.item10.detail: Demonstration of advocate workspace with case diary, act bookmarking, client communication summaries, and e-Courts status sync.

trust.title: Trust, Responsibility, and Important Limitations
trust.subtitle: Responsible legal technology requires complete honesty regarding capabilities and boundaries.
trust.point1.title: Jurisdiction and Facts Matter
trust.point1.desc: Legal outcomes depend heavily on specific facts, state amendments, local municipal laws, and current dates. Information provided may not apply to every unique scenario.
trust.point2.title: Sample Data Is Not Official Record
trust.point2.desc: All demonstration materials, statutes, and templates in this prototype are curated samples and must not be treated as certified court records.
trust.point3.title: Analysis Does Not Establish Legal Validity
trust.point3.desc: Automated document review highlights potential structural inconsistencies but cannot independently certify the legality or enforceability of any contract.
trust.point4.title: VIDHIVRAKSH Does Not Replace a Lawyer
trust.point4.desc: VIDHIVRAKSH is an educational awareness assistant. It does not provide legal representation, advocacy, or confidential attorney-client privilege.
trust.point5.title: Government Records Require Official Access
trust.point5.desc: Land registry, court case status, and official government portal features represent planned demonstration integrations requiring authorized state API access.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about VIDHIVRAKSH, our multilingual engine, and safety policies.
faq.a1: VIDHIVRAKSH currently supports six Indian languages: English, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Marathi, and Telugu. All interface components, explanations, and safety mechanisms operate natively across all six languages.
faq.q2: How does VIDHIVRAKSH ensure document privacy?
faq.a2: In this prototype, document processing is performed entirely locally without transmitting your queries or documents to third-party commercial LLMs or external advertising networks.
faq.q3: How accurate is the legal information?
faq.a3: Answers are grounded in curated statutory texts, including the new criminal codes (BNS, BNSS, BSA). However, because law evolves through judicial precedents, users should always verify provisions against official gazettes or consult an advocate.
faq.q4: Does VIDHIVRAKSH connect to live government court records?
faq.a4: Not in this hackathon demonstration. Features relating to land registry title checks and e-Courts case tracking are illustrated using structured mock records and planned integration designs.
faq.q5: What are the limitations of this prototype?
faq.a5: This application uses deterministic keyword retrieval and multilingual templates rather than a live external LLM. It is purpose-built to demonstrate responsible, accessible legal awareness without hallucinations or fabricated citations.
